scoring_justification: DAH exact values recomputed from analytical formulas; FFT trend verified as structural check to support claim of overestimation.

outputs.description: Effective out-of-plane piezoelectric coefficients computed by the double asymptotic homogenization (DAH) method and the fast Fourier transform (FFT) numerical method for a 2-1-2 epoxy/PZT composite with fixed fiber volume fraction 0.5 and piezoelectric layer volume fractions 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the DAH values to exact analytical results and the FFT values to paper reference values within specified tolerances, and verifies the sign trend e_DAH > e_FFT at each λ.

steps.description: Recompute DAH coefficients exactly and verify DAH > FFT trend
